name: Raid Recovery
teaser: Resume your raid after a crash.
description:
Description

Tested on an installation without other mods. It has not been tried yet next to a large mod list. Back up your profile first.

A mod for SPT 4.1 that lets you resume a raid after the game crashes.

What it does

SPT saves nothing until the raid ends. If the game crashes or freezes during a raid, the raid is lost: the loot you found, your kills and your quest progress are gone.

With this mod, the next time you reach the main menu after a crash, the game shows its “Return to raid” screen, the same as the live version:

  • Reconnect puts you back in the raid, where you were
  • Confirm leave gives you back the profile you had before the raid, gear included

There is no penalty for leaving.

How it works

The mod saves the raid every 30 seconds while you play. Only the latest save is kept, plus the one before as a spare. When the raid ends normally (you extract, you die, you leave), the save is deleted. If the game crashes, the save stays. You get it back at the menu.

A resumed raid can be resumed again. If the game crashes a second time, even during the loading screen, the raid is still there.

A save older than 24 hours is deleted.

Everything comes back as it was: your character, the raid, the loot, the bots and the bodies. Scav raids work too. The few things that do not come back are listed in the “Known limits” tab.

Getting started

Extract the archive into your SPT 4.1 folder, the one with BepInEx and SPT_Runtime. It adds two folders:

BepInEx/plugins/RaidRecovery/          the plugin of the game
SPT_Runtime/user/mods/RaidRecovery/    the mod of the server

Both are needed. To remove the mod, delete those two folders.

Settings

In the game

Press F12 in the game and look for Raid Recovery.

Setting Default Meaning
Enabled on Turns the saves on or off
Interval (seconds) 30 Time between two saves, from 15 to 120
Save now Saves right away, and shows the time of the last save
Save now (shortcut) none A key that does the same
Relaunch the raid automatically on Off: you start the raid yourself after reconnecting
Use the return-to-raid screen of the game on Off: you get a plain window instead
Keep the loot as the game sees it on Off: only the items you carry are removed from the loot
Keep bots and bodies on Off: the resumed raid spawns new bots
Bots that were after you still are on Off: bots come back unaware of you
Log measurements on Writes the cost and size of each save to the log

If a resumed raid does something wrong, turn off one of the last four settings to find which part is the cause. The rest of the mod keeps working.

On the server

In SPT_Runtime/user/mods/RaidRecovery/config.json:

Setting Default Meaning
maxAgeHours 24 A save older than this is deleted
maxResumesPerRaid 0 How many times one raid can be resumed. 0: no limit
blockResumeUnderVitalHealthPercent 0 A raid cannot be resumed if your head or thorax was under this percent of health. 0: never blocked

A raid refused by one of these rules ends like a raid you chose to leave: you go back to the profile you had before it.

Mod compatibility

Incompatibility First :)

  • Anything that tempers with the bot spawn system (for now)

Compatible with :

Fika

Raid Recovery works in co-op with its Fika add-on, vek-raidrecovery-fika.zip. When the host crashes, the host resumes the raid and the other players rejoin it, PMC or scav.

  • Every player of the group needs the mod and the add-on, in the same versions
  • The server mod goes once on the machine that runs the SPT server
  • Do not install the add-on without Fika. Without Fika, the game shows an error at every start

The add-on was made and tested with Fika 2.4.3.

Teammate mods

A teammate brought by a mod is not saved: its mod brings it back. Before, it came back as a stranger who shot at you.

Mod What happens on a resume
PIT Fireteam Your squad comes back with the raid. Only the teammates alive at the save come back
Miyako Carry Service Your squad comes back for the right side, PMC or scav

Nothing of this runs when no teammate mod is installed.

Using another mod and something goes wrong? Tell me which one, with your BepInEx/LogOutput.log.

Files and log

Saves are written by the server in SPT_Runtime/user/raid-recovery/. They are deleted when the raid ends. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

The log is BepInEx/LogOutput.log. The lines that start with Raid Recovery say what was saved and what was put back.
